lessons: evidence.json shipped at v1.0.0 on the LEGACY schema (id / source_fetched_at, no appears_in). The verifier read source_url and raw_snippet but extracted 0 facts, so the numeric gate had never actually run on this skill. Normalized to canonical keys this cycle and the gate immediately found 4 unjustified claims. Any sibling skill created in the same batch should be schema-checked before its next update.

The anti-fabrication rule was doing double duty as cover for omissions. It correctly forbids asserting volatile per-country visa status, but the skill had used that framing to stay silent on things that are stable and knowable: that an electronic-authorization CATEGORY exists, that adult exit orders exist, passport lead times, insurance exclusions. The rule now says so explicitly. Watch for the same pattern in any other live-lookup skill.

CARRY: customs personal exemption on return. An ordinary user would ask, and the commonly-cited figure (USD 200 per traveler) is everywhere in secondary sources, but no רשות המסים primary source could be reached this cycle. Source it properly or keep it out; do not publish the secondary figure.

CARRY: IDF exit clearance for draft-age travelers (מלש"ב / regular service). The constraint is surfaced in Step 6 as a confirm-with-your-enlistment-office item, but the actual procedure is deliberately unstated because mitgaisim.idf.il renders as a JS shell and the candidate gov.il service URL 404s. Find the real primary source next cycle.

CARRY: ETIAS. Israelis will need it once it starts, but the Q4-2026 target has been dropped and no launch date is set. Re-check each cycle; when a date is announced, the Step 2 authorization block needs a real row rather than the current pending note.

Deferred over the Phase 4.1 discretionary cap: apostille / document authentication for trips with a legal purpose, MFA WhatsApp and Telegram traveler-alert channels, and the insurer-to-assistance-company mapping published by the MFA (the skill now tells the traveler to write down the assistance number, but does not reproduce the mapping).

Reachability finding worth keeping: gov.il, kolzchut.org.il, chabad.org and iatatravelcentre.com ALL return HTTP 403 to plain curl while rendering fine in a browser. Two evidence entries were marked FAILED by --check-sources purely because of this. Never drop a citation from these hosts on a 403 alone.

The Chabad locator URL had silently become a permanent redirect (centers/default_cdo/... to /jewish-centers/). Link-checking caught it only because redirects were followed and compared, not because the status was non-200.

Eval gate ACCEPT, holdout 0.75 -> 1.00, no regressions. The gain came entirely from naming UK ETA and US ESTA in the description: an ETA is legally not a visa, so the old 'visa rules' wording gave a router no hook for electronic-authorization queries. CARRY: the added exit-restriction clause landed in the TRAIN split only, so its routing benefit is unmeasured, not proven. Put a stay-of-exit query in the holdout next cycle.
